text.title: eventId
text.description: ID of the new meeting. The flow reads the meeting, checks the rules, finds a free time, and confirms any move.

inputs.where: @equals(toLower(trim(coalesce(item()?['cr9b0_ruletext'],''))),'board meetings are critical and cannot be moved. any meeting that has "board meeting" in the subject is considered a board meeting.')
@equals(toLower(trim(coalesce(item()?['cr9b0_ruletext'],''))),'board meetings are critical and cannot be moved. any meeting that has "board meeting" in the subject is considered a board meeting.')

Explain_result.inputs: @if(equals(variables('Status'),'NoConflict'),'No conflict. No meeting was moved.',if(equals(variables('Status'),'Resolved'),concat('Conflict resolved. Confirmed moves: ',string(variables('MovedCount')),'. No email was needed.'),if(variables('ConflictFound'),concat('The conflict could not be fully resolved. Confirmed moves: ',string(variables('MovedCount')),'. Check the run details for protected meetings, unavailable time, changed rules, or a failed check.'),'The meeting could not be checked. No successful resolution was confirmed.')))

parameters.emailMessage/Body:
A calendar conflict could not be fully resolved automatically.

Meeting: @{replace(replace(replace(coalesce(body('Read_new_meeting')?['subject'],'Meeting'),'&','&'),'<','<'),'>','>')}

Original time (UTC): @{body('Read_new_meeting')?['start']?['dateTime']} to @{body('Read_new_meeting')?['end']?['dateTime']}

@{outputs('Explain_result')}

Open the calendar and review the conflict. Board meetings must stay at their original times.
